decisions.question: How should the coordinator handle long-running tasks that exceed a single Claude session?

options.label: Checkpoint/resume
options.description: Checkpoint/resume: save state to orchestrator and resume from checkpoints

options.label: Stateless
options.description: Stateless: re-derive state from orchestrator on each invocation

options.label: Persistent session
options.description: Persistent session: keep coordinator session alive indefinitely

decisions.question: How should gateway phase enforcement work when the coordinator can dynamically skip/reorder phases?

options.label: Flexible phases
options.description: Flexible phases: coordinator declares current phase, gateway enforces that phase's rules

options.label: Phase-free mode
options.description: Phase-free mode: coordinator operates with relaxed phase restrictions

options.label: Phase templates
options.description: Phase templates: predefined phase sequences the coordinator selects from

decisions.question: What should the coordinator be able to do without human approval?

options.label: Minimal authority
options.description: Minimal authority: spawn agents and monitor only; all phase advances need human approval

options.label: Moderate authority
options.description: Moderate authority: spawn agents, skip phases, loop back; PR creation needs human approval

options.label: Maximum authority
options.description: Maximum authority: fully autonomous up to PR merge (which always requires human)

decisions.question: How much of the coordinator system should be built in the first iteration?

options.label: MVP
options.description: MVP: coordinator tools + flexible agent spawning API only

options.label: Core
options.description: Core: tools + flexible spawning + dynamic phase selection + basic monitoring

options.label: Full
options.description: Full: tools + spawning + phase skipping + adaptive loops + workflow templates

questions.question: What cost limits or guardrails should be applied to coordinator sessions? (e.g., max tokens per task, max agent spawns, dollar budget)
What should happen when the coordinator session crashes mid-task? Should running agents continue autonomously, pause and wait, or be stopped?
Should the coordinator manage multiple related issues simultaneously, or is one-issue-at-a-time sufficient for v1?
How should users interact with the coordinator? (Slack, GitHub issue comments, dedicated CLI, existing egg command, or some combination?)
